description_en: Queries the information about the assets to which a baseline check policy is applied
description_zh: 查询基线检查策略生效的资产的信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-strategy-target --type hc_strategy --config strategyId_:8167126 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeStrategyTarget

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The type of the policy. Set the value to hc_strategy, which indicates baseline check policies
parameters.help_zh: 设置查询类型。此处为固定值：hc_strategy，表示查询基线策略
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline check policy
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的基线检查策略的ID
parameters.name: config

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

StrategyTargets.description_en: The information about the assets to which the baseline check policy is applied
StrategyTargets.description_zh: 策略生效的资产的信息列表

items.description_zh: 策略生效的资产的信息

BindUuidCount.description_en: The number of the assets that belong to the asset group
BindUuidCount.description_zh: 资产分组中绑定的资产的数量

Flag.description_en:
Indicates whether the baseline check policy is applied to the asset group. Valid values:

add: The baseline check policy is applied to the asset group.
del: the baseline check policy is not applied to the asset group
Flag.description_zh:
策略是否对该资产分组生效。取值：

add：对该资产分组生效
del：不对该资产分组生效

Target.description_en: The ID of the asset group to which the assets belong or the UUID of the asset

TargetType.description_en:
The method that is used to add the assets to the baseline check policy. Valid values:

groupId: the ID of the asset group
uuid: the UUID of the asset
TargetType.description_zh:
策略生效的资产的添加方式。取值：

groupId：按照资产的分组添加。
uuid：按照单个资产添加
